title: rosa canina var. oxyphylla
intro: Rosa canina var. oxyphylla, commonly known as the dwarf or compact dog rose, is a variant of the dog rose plant (Rosa canina) that is characterized by its smaller size and more compact growth habit. This plant is rich in health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to protect against cell damage, reduce inflammation, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of Rosa canina var. oxyphylla include wound healing, anti-anxiety, and anti-depressive effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including vitamins C and E, polyphenols, and carotenoids, are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
